title: Celestin's touring route
summary: Celestin's band toured Louisiana, Shreveport, Dallas, Florida and Mobile; Moore says his Texas time comes later.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Okay, how about -- I think actually before you went to New York you mentioned that you had gone to Texas. You played in Dallas. Just exactly when does that come along? Does that precede your going with Harlan Leonard -- could you tell us a little bit about that?
This is at a later time. It will come later. If we're going to tell you about sequence, this is a few more years later, after I came back from New York.
So your main band, even though you
